summary: Tested the Owner-only revision end to end. Backend: 20 of 20 new pytest cases pass, covering two-step identify then PIN auth, consent enforcement, token-type separation, Owner endpoints, zero-data reports, the post-reset DB state and rank-tier boundaries. Frontend: the full Owner browser login works (consent requires scrolling, PIN entry, wrong-PIN toast, success redirect). /reports renders tabs, filters, date filter, Excel/PDF downloads and a zero state with no static data. No horizontal overflow on desktop 1920 or mobile 390 for login or reports.

minor.issue: The endpoint looks up the account before checking consent, so an unknown identifier returns 404 even when consent is false. This allows account enumeration: the response differs depending on whether the username exists. Better: validate consent first, and consider rate-limiting identify.

The lockout key is request.client.host + user_id. Behind the k8s ingress, client.host is probably the proxy IP, so 5 bad PINs from anyone could lock the account for every user for 15 minutes. Use X-Forwarded-For. Lockout was not executed live so the Owner account would not get locked.
Uses the ANY dependency. Any authenticated admin or barteam user can list every user, including the Owner. Consider restricting this.

Uses the ANY dependency, so riders can see the GPS positions of all on-duty riders. The DB also still holds 3 gps docs and 2 attendance docs left over from deleted riders. These were not part of the reset; consider purging them.

CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True reflects any Origin (tested with https://evil.com). Auth uses Bearer tokens and no httpOnly cookies, so the risk is low, but explicit origins are recommended.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid was passed to the custom Select, which only accepts a testId prop, so the attribute was missing. FIXED by the testing agent.

integration_issues.issue: If the API fails, .catch sets report to null and the page silently shows only the header controls. There is no error or loading state.
The Cetak button calls exportPdf (it downloads the PDF) instead of opening a print dialog.

issues: The 6th PIN box runs past the card's right padding and touches the card edge. Use flex-1 or a smaller width for the boxes.
The date range uses the browser's native date input (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the shadcn calendar.
The header shows only a faint 'OWNER' label with no page title; the header avatar circle is empty.
The consent check icons are very small (w-3) and have low visibility.

action_items: In /auth/identify, validate consent before the account lookup and consider rate limiting
Use the real client IP (X-Forwarded-For) for the PIN lockout key
Add an error and loading state to Reports.jsx; make Cetak call window.print or a print-specific view
Fix the mobile PIN box row overflowing the card padding
Optionally purge orphan gps/attendance docs and set explicit CORS origins
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1823 lines; split it into routers (auth, users, inventory, reports, gps)
GET /users and GET /gps/active are too permissive for non-owner roles
test_credentials: Owner baa / PIN 130994 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). pin_hash is bcrypt $2b$.
seed_data_creation: None. No users or records were created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Only Owner baa exists. After the reset, materials (18) and menus (9) have stock 0; sales, expenses and the other transaction collections are empty. The brute-force lockout was deliberately not triggered to avoid locking the Owner account. Role-restriction tests for Admin/Bar Team/Rider were not possible without creating users (forbidden in this run).
